question: Where are the eight supernatural powers located in relation to the three-eyed deity?
premises: These powers are situated in the hands
They belong to the three-eyed one with a manifested face
inference: The eight supernatural powers rest in the hands of the three-eyed deity whose face is manifested.
uncertainties: The referent of 'teṣām' may link to practitioners or to aspects of the deity.
plain_english: For them, the eight powers are situated in the hands of the three-eyed one, whose face is manifested.
